title: Western Star 4800-4900 Hi-Tensile Aluminium FUPS Road Train Bullbar #6
description: Western Star 4800-4900 polished hi-tensile aluminium FUPS Bullbar. Choice of 76mm or 88mm heavy duty walled diameter pipe. One piece pipes on main cross pipes pass through drilled heavy duty narrow depth uprights, no butt welds. The narrow uprights reduce the forward projection measurement and suit tight maximum overall length restrictions. Road Train signs with removable covers. Indicator repeaters on main bar which is contoured to match the front wheel profile. Heavy duty steel backing plate with tow pin. Driving light mounts fitted to suit customer requirements. Provision for lower front mud flaps.
